subject: E-3307: quota exceeded on macOS
body:
Good morning. My setup is MeshMail 2.8.4, macOS 14.7. Since last week, every time I upload a file, I
get 'E-3307: storage quota exceeded'.

Yesterday's plan upgrade is not reflected, the old limit is still shown. The web console already
shows the new allowance.

I've already tried waiting a day, which changed nothing.

Priya Nair - Caldera Foods. Appreciate any pointers.
